title: Bollard + Post Top
headline: Replaces up to 1000W HID.
intro: Keep the look and feel of your existing fixture, while saving energy and maintenance costs. Several models feature FlexWatt and FlexColor allowing for substantial sku reduction and in-field adjustability.
callouts: LED-8000 — multiple voltage options & longer neck for a better fit
